request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT

layers.text: Make the two red cloth banners much wider and longer so together they cover most of the front of the obelisk, in one deep crimson red with darker crimson shading and no orange highlights. Keep the beige stone obelisk, golden star, small stone footing, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under it.
